notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Ghired.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
